parsed.text: This packet reports fallible location distributions on 4×4 local grids for red and blue roles at four addressed nodes, in two panels (p0,p1). Panel-level current views copy prior records (not new estimates); candidate entries are conditional command estimates (not executed events). Current, panel p0: node n0 — blue mass concentrated on four top-right cells (rows 0–1, cols 2–3), red mass concentrated on four top-left cells (rows 0–1, cols 0–1). Nodes n1 and n2 are uniform in current p0. Node n3 in current p0 has a blue peak at (1,1) and a red peak at (0,2). Panel p1 current matches p0 for n0 and shows uniform distributions at n1–n3. Across conditional command records, node n0 distributions vary by command: many candidate entries place blue peak at (0,2) and red peak at (0,0) with differing sharpness; some candidate snapshots show the multi-cell pattern for n0. Copied prior records and conditional records are presented as data only; no physical presence or event occurrence is asserted.
